doc.title: Ray Conniff interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 14, 1998

title: Latin albums for South American audiences
summary: The Latin division asked for an all-Latin album, which succeeded in South America and led to several more.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: And plus your records now, over the years, have been very popular in those countries, in addition to here.

Yeah. One period of time, after quite a few years with the label that I originally went with, I got a call from the Latin division and they said they were getting a lot of calls from South American countries who wanted Ray Conniff to do an album of just Latin music. And so I did my first Latin album, it was called something Latino — Simply Latino [“Latinisimo”], was that it? I can’t remember. But anyway after that it became very successful in South America, and I did quite a few after that, beamed right out to Latin countries only.
